caption: The drawing depicts a small, hexagonal-shaped bag with a dark green color. The bag is suspended by a twisted green cord handle that forms a loop at the top and is adorned with green tassels on each side where the handle joins the bag. The main part of the bag features an embroidered floral design in the center, with a large flower in shades of gold and brown and leaves in a combination of green and gold, with additional blue and red accents on some petals and leaves. The edges of the bag are trimmed with a twisted, multicolored cord in green, gold, and red. The background is plain, with no additional objects or patterns, highlighting the bag as the central object in the drawing.
title: Handbag
